info.title: MACsec_Secure_Channel
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

channel_type.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Channel](#/MACsec_Secure_Channel)
The type of Secure Channel (SC). `receive`: This SC will be used to process traffic received from the peer(s). `transmit`: This SC will be used when transmitting traffic to the peer(s).

create_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot at which the SC was created.

hw_status.description: The status of the SC in hardware.

error_code.description: Applicable only when the 'state' is set to 'error'.

state.description: The state of the SC in hardware.  `ok`:          The hardware was successful in creating the                 SC.  `in_progress`: The hardware is currently processing the                 SC.  `error`:       The hardware has encountered an error in                 creating the SC.

sci.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Channel](#/MACsec_Secure_Channel)
Unique identifier for a given secure channel. It comprises the MAC address and a unique port number corresponding to the interface that this secure channel is instantiated for.

secure_associations.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Secure_Association](#/MACsec_Secure_Association)
Set of MACsec Secure Associations uniquely identified by association number.

delayed_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received with a packet number (PN) lower than the lowest acceptable PN across all secure associations (SAs) that existed on the SC.

encrypted_packets_tx.description: Number of encrypted packets transmitted on the SC with integrity protection.

late_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received with a PN lower than the lowest acceptable PN that were discarded across all secure associations (SAs) that existed on the SC.

not_valid_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets discarded that failed validation when validate frames is set in 'strict' mode or when the packet was encrypted across all secure associations (SAs) that existed on the SC.

ok_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received that were validated successfully across all secure associations (SAs) that existed on the SC.

protected_packets_tx.description: Number of unencrypted packets transmitted on the SC with integrity protection.

secy.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_SecY](#/MACsec_SecY)
SecY associated with this secure channel.

ssci.description: A 32-bit value managed by the KaY. It is unique for each SCI within the context of all MAC Security Entities (SecYs) using a given Secure Association Key (SAK). It is used in the validation functions of the GCM-AES-XPN Cipher Suites.

start_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when this SC started transmitting or receiving frames.

stop_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when this SC last received or transmitted frames.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
